title: Hiring & Onboarding Sync — Interview Debriefs (2026-03-31)
content:
Date: 2026-03-31
Attendees: Priya Nair (notes), Alex Murphy, Jamie Lee, Carlos Rivera, Sam Patel
Duration: 45m

Purpose:
- Weekly hiring + onboarding sync focused on interview debriefs, new hire ramp status, and team health check-ins.

Agenda:
1) Quick headcount recap and open reqs
2) Interview debriefs (last 7 days)
3) Onboarding status for hires in first 30 days
4) Action items / blockers
5) Priorities for next week

---

1) Headcount / open reqs (snapshot)
- Current team headcount (platform-engineering): 62
- Active reqs: 6 (Backend Eng x2, Infra SRE x1, Oncall Engineer x1, Applied ML infra x1, DevEx x1)
- Hiring priority this quarter: Backend Eng (2), Applied ML infra (1)
- Notes: Budget approved for +3 hires (see JIRA-ENG-4321). Slowdowns expected if we don't convert current onsites.

2) Interview debriefs (candidates interviewed 3/24–3/30)
- Candidate: "R. Chen" (Backend Engineer) — Interviewers: Alex M., Jamie L.
  - Strengths: solid system design, clear latency/cost tradeoff thinking, concrete examples scaling message bus.
  - Concerns: limited experience with GPU infra and model-serving specifics.
  - Score: 7/10
  - Recommendation: take-home assignment (focused on design + small implementation) before onsite.

- Candidate: "M. Lopez" (Applied ML Infra) — Interviewers: Carlos R., Sam P.
  - Strengths: experience with KV cache strategies, worked on a large-scale batching system, good debugging examples.
  - Concerns: slightly vague on kernel-selection and quantization tradeoffs, but eager to learn.
  - Score: 8/10
  - Recommendation: move to onsite loop and include a short technical deep-dive with Serving Runtime team.

- Candidate: "S. Osei" (DevEx) — Interviewers: Jamie L., Priya N.
  - Strengths: great documentation instincts, experience building onboarding flows, strong cross-team communication examples.
  - Concerns: small sample size on infra debugging.
  - Score: 7.5/10
  - Recommendation: final on-site with PM/Developer Experience lead.

Notes: Interviewers flagged consistency issues across our question set — need to sync rubric for Applied ML Infra. Action: Alex to propose 3 standard rubric adjustments by 2026-04-05.

3) Onboarding status (new hires, <30 days)
- New hire: "Dana Kim" (SRE) — Start date 2026-03-10
  - Completed: HR onboarding, laptop issued (OK), Slack, GitHub access, basic infra walkthrough.
  - In progress: Production runbook review, pairing with oncall buddy (Sam P.), access to monitoring dashboards pending (KMS ticket: JIRA-SEC-987).
  - Blockers: KMS admin approval delayed — Priya to escalate to Security.

- New hire: "Eli Turner" (Backend) — Start date 2026-03-22
  - Completed: dev env, local build, first PR merged (non-prod).
  - In progress: onboarding project (mini feature to validate serving runtime local dev flow).
  - Feedback: Eli suggests a step-by-step developer checklist (add to Confluence page CONFLUENCE-ENG-ONBOARD-2).

- New hire: "Priyanka Sharma" (Applied ML infra) — Start date 2026-03-25
  - Completed: team intros, model-serving primer session.
  - In progress: pairing sessions with Carlos R., assigned to kernel-selection doc review.
  - Blockers: queued access to dedicated GPU cluster for experiments (infra ticket JIRA-INF-210).

General onboarding notes:
- Action: Create a "first 30 days" checklist PDF and link on team Confluence (Priya to draft by 2026-04-07).
- Consider a 2-week "shadow oncall" for new SREs to reduce cognitive load at ramp time.

4) Team health / retro-style notes
- Mood: Mixed — most folks positive about product momentum, but some fatigue around repeated context-switching (noted across infra + devex).
- Recent wins: Serving runtime latency improvements rolled out (30% tail reduction last sprint) — good morale boost.
- Key pain: Interview-to-offer lead time has stretched to 25 days on average. Causes: missing interview rubrics, scheduling friction.
- Suggestion: Reserve two block slots per week for interviewers (Fri mornings suggested) to reduce scheduling burnout.

5) Action items / owners
- Alex M.: Draft standardized Applied ML Infra rubric and share by 2026-04-05 (linked to JIRA-ENG-4321).
- Priya N.: Escalate KMS admin approval for Dana (due 2026-04-02) and draft first-30-days checklist (due 2026-04-07).
- Carlos R.: Schedule technical deep-dive for M. Lopez and confirm onsite loop (due 2026-04-03).
- Jamie L.: Work with DevEx on a short onboarding checklist PR (target 2026-04-06).
- Recruiting: prioritize converting shortlist for Backend Eng reqs, target 2 onsite slots next week.

Open questions / parking lot:
- Should we require a short "model-serving primer" as a pre-req for Applied ML infra candidates? (Parked — discuss with Research/Serving Runtime leads)
- How to measure onboarding success beyond PR count in first 30 days? Propose 3 metrics (mentorship sessions, docs completed, first production deploy) — Priya to propose.

Misc / Notes to self:
- Add links to the candidate scorecards on Greenhouse (internal link) in Confluence summary.
- Follow up with Security on KMS SLA for new hires.
- Recruiter asked for a one-pager on "what success looks like in first 90 days" for Backend hires — create draft.

Next sync: 2026-04-07 (weekly)

---

Raw/working items (informal)
- Quick checklist fragment: laptop + VPN + SSO + GitHub + Slack + monitoring + KMS + pager access.
- Note: Jamie to add more explicit guidance on take-home assignments (timebox to 4 hours max).
- Candidate pool comment: more folks with infra + LLM experience in April grads — coordinate with campus recruiting for Applied ML infra req.

End of notes.
